fields.claim_text: string — verbatim text of the advertising claim
fields.violated_rule: string — plain English description of the rule violated
fields.citable_section: string — the CFR section or FTC guidance document
fields.evidence_required: string — what evidence would substantiate the claim

example_entry.claim_text: Clinically demonstrated to support immune function
example_entry.violated_rule: Proof claim without adequate RCT substantiation
example_entry.citable_section: FTC Health Products Compliance Guidance Dec 2022
example_entry.evidence_required: At least one well-controlled RCT demonstrating the specific claim
example_entry.recommendation: Remove 'clinically demonstrated' language; replace with evidence-qualified claim
